title: UAAP: FEU spoils Hubalde’s debut as UE interim coach
summary: Far Eastern University spoiled Paulo Hubalde’s debut as interim coach of University of the East with a win in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Saturday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
